title: Teach agents to write owner briefs at Lock and at deferral
action:
Write every sentence through the bee-technical-writing skill. Per D1-D12 of docs/history/owner-brief/CONTEXT.md.

1. New knowledge concept docs/knowledge/areas/decision-memory/owner-brief-contract.md, in the frontmatter and section shape of backlog-store.md beside it. It is the ONE home of the contract: the path, the frontmatter keys and enums, the six labels for vi and en and the `brief.language` key (D3), the 120-220 word rule and how words are counted (D1), the forbidden body content (D2), who writes it and when (the adding agent through `bee backlog pbi add --brief-file` or `bee backlog propose --brief-file`; bee-shaping Lock for `docs/briefs/<feature>.md`; deferral with the reason and cost in the cost paragraph — D4, D11), what happens with no brief (added and flagged), the check `bee backlog briefs [--id <id>] [--json]` and its exit code (D8), the doctor note (D9), the live and active definitions (D5, D6), and the folding rule stated for consumers in one plain paragraph (D7) — consumers such as waggledance and agent-works apply the same rule; `docs/backlog.md` is the internal ledger (D10). Include one GOOD example: the full text of docs/history/owner-brief/brief-draft.md in a fenced block. Include one BAD example: the one-line CoS `A comment by a person on a mirrored task reaches the mapped project's leader as a dispatch; deferred from wd-mirror shaping`, followed by why it fails (no why, no cost, no reason for the deferral, no ask, an internal slug the owner cannot read). Pointers section names packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/brief.rs, verbs/backlog.rs and doctor.rs. Add its index line to docs/knowledge/areas/decision-memory/index.md in the existing list style, and one sentence plus link in backlog-store.md where the PBI add door is described.

2. skills/bee-shaping/SKILL.md: in `## Lock (single writer)`, add a short paragraph: Lock also writes `docs/briefs/<feature>.md`, the owner brief, drawn from the Feature Boundary and the Locked Decisions in the owner language, and checks it with `bee backlog briefs --id <feature>`; the contract lives in the concept (link it by repo-relative path). Replace the two `bee backlog add` deferral mentions that defer product scope (the `Defer scope creep with` line in Explore and the `Deferred ideas that are real future work get` line in Lock) with `bee backlog pbi add --brief-file <draft>` whose cost paragraph says why the scope moved out and what waiting costs. Keep the Qualify and Brief sections as they are.

3. skills/bee-planning/SKILL.md: in `## Scope integrity`, add one or two sentences: scope that moves out of the plan into the backlog goes through `bee backlog pbi add --brief-file <draft>`, with the reason for moving it and its cost in the cost paragraph; link the concept.

4. skills/bee-capturing/SKILL.md: the deferral bullet in `## Capture the moment it settles` that sends user-deferred work to `bee backlog add` sends product work to `bee backlog pbi add --brief-file <draft>` instead (friction and findings keep `bee backlog add`); link the concept.

5. Copy docs/history/owner-brief/brief-draft.md byte-identical to docs/briefs/owner-brief.md.

6. Run `.bee/bin/bee dev regen` (render-skill-trees, onboard --apply, release-manifest --write) so every rendered skill copy and docs/history/codex-harness-hardening/release-manifest.json match (never hand-edit a rendered copy); commit the regen output with the rest. Then prove: `.bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check` green, `rg -l 'brief-file' skills/bee-shaping/SKILL.md skills/bee-planning/SKILL.md skills/bee-capturing/SKILL.md docs/knowledge/areas/decision-memory/owner-brief-contract.md` prints four paths, and `cmp docs/briefs/owner-brief.md docs/history/owner-brief/brief-draft.md` exits 0. One commit, imperative subject, trailer `cell: ob-2`.
